pieces.Text: Three times per day as a swift action, an asavir can call out a challenge. Each opponent within 30 feet must succeed at a Will save (DC

) or be distracted by the display until the beginning of the asavir's next turn. Any creature that fails is considered to be flat-footed and takes a -2 penalty to AC against attacks from the asavir's allies. This is a mind-affecting, visual effect.
